questions.question: [Cinematography] Q: Explain the difference between high-key and low-key lighting and their typical narrative effects.
questions.correctAnswer: High-key lighting is bright, even and minimises shadows, creating an optimistic, safe or comedic tone often used in rom-coms and sitcoms.
